# Lucas Semenya

> Lucas Semenya is a South African founder, AI developer, product engineer, and mechanical engineer. He founded Bespoke Applications Labs and builds AI-native products, autonomous agent systems, full-stack applications, and business automation.

Canonical website: https://lucassemenya.co.za

## Location

Lucas is based between Limpopo and Gauteng and works with organisations across South Africa, including Lephalale, Polokwane, Pretoria, Johannesburg, North West, and Mpumalanga.

## Expertise

- AI application development and LLM pipelines
- Autonomous and multi-agent systems
- Full-stack web and mobile engineering
- Business process automation
- Product architecture and platform strategy
- Creative technology, Three.js, and WebGL
- Mechanical engineering, maintenance planning, and condition monitoring

## Selected work

- [CarShareNova](https://carsharenova.com): South African peer-to-peer car rental marketplace.
- [Msaada](https://msaada.app): Platform supporting gig workers with equipment, payments, tasks, and earnings tools.
- [Bespoke Applications Labs](https://www.bespokeapps.co.za): AI products, software platforms, and autonomous agent systems.
- [Bonram](https://bonram.co.za): Multi-service B2B operations platform and company website.
- [The Safety Shelf](https://safety-shelf.co.za): AI-driven health and safety bookstore and management platform.
- [555chess](https://555chess.co.za): Personalised online chess tutoring with real expert coaches.
- [Bonram Rentals](https://bonramrentals.co.za): Luxury and professional event rentals.

Lucas has also built Malume, School Record, BespokeHQ, the NUM Case Portal, and the NSFAS Admin Portal. NUM and NSFAS are private-client systems.

## Agent systems

- FRIDAY: operations and orchestration.
- NOVA: content strategy and execution.
- ULTRON: systems architecture, audit, and security review.
